text: P states that MARS-RA turns LMM-generated contribution pairwise comparisons into rank-aggregated contribution scores for potential-based reward shaping, with robustness to noise and dynamic participation. Q instead seeks honesty and obedience under hidden alignment/capability and characterizes implementability by nested cyclical monotonicity. These are not the same guarantee: robustness of score estimation or learning convergence does not establish incentive compatibility against agents who strategically alter the evidence being compared.

I reject the abstract-scan proposal in its literal plug-in form. If MARS-RA remains merely potential-based shaping, then under the usual policy-invariance role of potential shaping it cannot by itself change which strategic behavior maximizes an agent objective; hence it cannot generally make hidden-type honesty/obedience optimal or repair sandbagging. Q requires an allocation/transfer (or continuation-value) instrument satisfying implementability constraints, not only a better ordinal credit estimator. P provides no strategic-deception claim in the supplied text.

A concrete publishable line is a separation theorem plus repair: comparison-derived, report-independent potential shaping cannot implement truthful revelation of concealable capability; implementation becomes possible only when rank scores enter type/report-contingent transfers or continuation rewards whose induced allocation obeys Q nested cyclical monotonicity (and peer signals meet the needed informativeness conditions). Test the sharp boundary experimentally by holding the MARS comparison pipeline fixed and comparing (A) shaping only, (B) raw rank bonuses, and (C) an NCM-constrained transfer layer under capable-agent sandbagging and misaligned manipulation. Outcome: a supported negative theorem and a mechanism repair, rather than a generic robustness test.

Evidence is limited to the supplied abstracts. Q explicitly mentions one-sided imitation (capabilities can be concealed but not counterfeited), sandbagging, peer scoring, reward coupling, and reward shaping; P explicitly claims robustness to noise and changing participation and effective cooperation. Neither abstract supports claiming that MARS-RA is strategyproof, that its comparisons are proper peer scores, or that NCM automatically applies to its rank aggregation. Those remain assumptions to formalize and test.

Unresolved: specify agent utility and whether shaped reward is the true payoff or only a training aid; define how reports/actions affect pairwise-comparison signals; derive the exact NCM inequalities for the finite capability/alignment type model; and check whether MARS rank aggregation is monotone under unilateral contribution suppression, sybil/participation changes, or collusion. The main claim should remain conditional until full papers or formal definitions are available.

Final synthesis after re-reading Q and P: confirm one publishable conditional separation-and-repair line, reject the literal plug-in hypothesis. Q says mechanisms must incentivize both honesty and obedience, capability can be concealed but not counterfeited, and implementable policies are characterized by NCM. P says LMM-generated pairwise contribution comparisons become rank-aggregated scores for potential-based reward shaping, with convergence and robustness to noise and changing participation. Therefore, under a standard discounted telescoping PBRS construction with compatible terminal treatment and fixed underlying utility, report-independent MARS-RA shaping preserves continuation-return orderings and cannot make previously profitable sandbagging strictly truthful. Repair requires scores to enter a report/type-contingent transfer or continuation contract whose induced allocation satisfies Q-style NCM, plus identifiability of concealed capability from comparison distributions.

The strongest unavoidable limit is observational equivalence: if a high-capability sandbagger and a genuinely low-capability agent induce the same distribution of MARS comparisons, no score-only transfer can separate them. NCM constrains implementability of the full policy/instrument; it does not create information and cannot be enforced on ranks alone. The paper should state this as an impossibility condition and test departures from it, not promise that NCM restores honesty unconditionally.

Remaining unresolved: P abstract omits the exact potential formula, stationarity, terminal convention, and whether shaping is training reward or deployment utility; Q abstract omits the formal NCM inequalities needed for the finite model. Obtain full definitions before theorem proof. Minimal study: two capability by two alignment types; endogenous pairwise-comparison channel; shaping-only versus raw rank bonus versus NCM-constrained transfer; unilateral sandbagging as the primary test, with collusion and entry/exit secondary.
